structure.unit: School Boards; Selection, Qualification and Salaries of Members
Method of Selecting School Boards in School Divisions Composed of a Single County

law.text: The school board in each county constituting a school division, except a county to which the provisions of §§ 15.2-410, 15.2-531, 15.2-627, 15.2-837 or § 22.1-44 are applicable, shall be selected as provided in this article.
